item.title: FDA Commissioner Makary Exit
item.description:
• Summary: Multiple reports indicate that President Trump has signed off on plans to oust FDA Commissioner Marty Makary. Makary's tenure has been controversial, drawing significant attention from industry stakeholders. Lawmakers and former FDA leaders have weighed in on the situation, which is expected to have broad implications for the agency's direction.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma, STAT News, BioSpace, Endpoints News

item.title: Mifepristone Supreme Court
item.description:
• Summary: Lawmakers and former FDA leaders are rallying behind mifepristone as the Supreme Court weighs the drug's fate. The case could have broad implications for FDA authority and drug access. A broad coalition has filed amicus briefs supporting continued access to the abortion pill.
  • MoAs: Mifepristone is a progesterone receptor antagonist that blocks the hormone needed for pregnancy to continue, used in medication abortion.
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma, STAT News

item.title: Japan FY26 Price Revision
item.description:
• Summary: Japan's FY26 drug price revision is expected to impact pharmaceutical companies operating in the country. The annual revision process adjusts reimbursement prices, affecting market dynamics and company revenues. Analysts assess potential implications for global drugmakers.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: AI in Pharma R&D
item.description:
• Summary: The role of artificial intelligence in pharmaceutical R&D is evolving, with AI-guided labs approaching full autonomy. However, there is a talent gap as young AI experts often shun careers at large drugmakers, preferring tech companies. The industry continues to explore AI to accelerate drug discovery.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology, Endpoints News

item.title: Targeted Protein Degradation
item.description:
• Summary: A sponsored feature discussing the emergence of targeted protein degradation (TPD) as a frontline modality in drug discovery. The piece covers key technological advances, major players, and the potential of TPD to address previously undruggable targets, signaling a shift in the pharmaceutical R&D landscape.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma

item.title: FDA EBVallo Leqembi Iqlik Argenx Blackstone Anagram
item.description:
• Summary: A roundup of recent FDA actions and corporate moves, including updates on EBVallo (cell therapy for EBV), Leqembi (lecanemab for Alzheimer's), Iqlik, Argenx (efgartigimod), Blackstone's investments, and Anagram's pipeline. The article provides a snapshot of regulatory decisions, funding deals, and strategic shifts affecting the biopharma sector.
  • MoAs: Lecanemab: Anti-amyloid beta monoclonal antibody. EBVallo: Allogeneic T-cell therapy targeting EBV. Argenx (efgartigimod): FcRn antagonist.
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive

item.title: Pharma Tariff Reality
item.description:
• Summary: An analysis of the practical impact of tariffs on the pharmaceutical industry, examining supply chain vulnerabilities, cost pressures on drug manufacturers, and potential pricing implications. The article discusses how recent trade policies are reshaping sourcing and manufacturing decisions.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma

item.title: FDA Gender Rule Change
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA announces a pilot program that changes gender-based rules for inspections, moving towards a more equitable and inclusive process. The article outlines the rationale and expected impact on regulatory oversight, emphasizing transparency and fairness in facility evaluations.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News

item.title: Medicare Pediatric Medical Devices
item.description:
• Summary: Medicare introduces a rapid pathway for pediatric medical devices, aiming to accelerate access to innovative technologies for children. The article details the program's eligibility criteria, reimbursement structure, and potential implications for device developers and young patients.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News

item.title: Former FDA Regulators Exit
item.description:
• Summary: A report explores the reasons behind a wave of former FDA regulators leaving the agency, including burnout, low morale, and attractive private-sector opportunities. The article discusses the potential consequences for regulatory expertise and drug review timelines, and calls for reforms to retain talent.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News
